tasks.task: Implement DesignDocsGenerator class (AC: #1) Create class in rustybt/validation/reporting.py Load all DESIGN-classified findings from all sessions Group findings by layer (signals, orders, broker, etc.) Group similar findings by description pattern Test: Unit tests for grouping logic

Extract user-friendly content (AC: #1) Use design_rationale from Finding for Difference section Use user_impact from Finding for Impact section Generate recommendations based on design_choice Write in user-friendly, non-technical language where possible Test: Verify content extraction from findings

Implement auto-update mechanism (AC: #2) Add hook to SessionManager on finding classification Regenerate docs when new DESIGN finding added Timestamp update in document header Preserve custom additions if any (via markers) Test: Verify auto-update triggers

Add CLI docs generate command (AC: #3) Add docs subcommand group to CLI Implement docs generate command Save to docs/validation/design-differences.md Also generate bug-fixes.md for resolved BUGs Test: CLI integration tests
Write comprehensive tests (AC: #1-3) Test with no DESIGN findings Test with multiple DESIGN findings Test grouping by layer and pattern Test auto-update mechanism
